QUOTE: `app/hooks/navigation_header.tsx` also builds a header, but it renders the inner `Header` from `components/navigation_header/header.tsx`, not `NavigationHeader`. The thread route in `app/routes/(authenticated)/thread.tsx` does the same.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer excludes the hook and the thread route from the renderer list and says they render the separate `Header` component.
